item.title: iBitch
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Topological Kagura
  • 発売日: 2013-08-14
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: iビッチ
  • 英語名: iBitch

あらすじ

One morning the Protagonist! (P!) wakes up to a buzz from his phone.

Aww. Junk mail.

He follows the URL to a site for the “iBitch”, which promises control over other people,

and soon he’s wielding it on all sorts of idols! Violation!

In the middle of class, in the storage cupboard, at the pool, at the library…
